status: Research measurement pipeline, not a surge model or an80% precision claim. Bounded manually invoked capture; no schedule, no trading or notifications.
source: Bybit public spot orderbook1000 andpublicTrade. Snapshot replaces full state; delta inserts/updates/deletes per price. u=1 requires snapshot. Non-monotone u/seq/cts or malformed/crossed books trigger resynchronization. IDs are not assumed contiguous; sequence jumps alone do not prove gaps. Same trade seq can contain multiple unique trades; deduplicate only trade ID within5min received-time cache.
timing: Store original source timestamps, wallclock arrival and monotonic elapsed time. Features use receive-time60sec windows and1sec book samples, only information already received. No future trade/event labels. Warm up after every connection/snapshot. Reject sample gaps>2.5sec,books not updated for>30sec anywhere inwindow. This conservative freshness rule may exclude legitimately unchanged books; not proof of missing data.
price_band: Use fixed midpoint at window start,plus/minus25bp (0.25%). Require captured depth to span relevant band throughoutwindow; insufficient coverage is null/partial,never zero. Midprice moving through band is reported separately.

features.ask_depth_change: End displayed ask notional in[anchor,anchor+25bp]/start-1; last10sec max ratio records whether depletion persisted. Interpret alongside non-RPI taker buy flow,not as cancellation identity.
features.bid_recovery: (End displayed bid notional minus minimum sampled bid notional during60sec)/start notional,band[anchor-25bp,anchor]. Accompany with sellflow andprice change. Sampling at1sec can miss faster extrema.
features.ask_cost_change: Change in displayed ask notional up to anchor+25bp. Null when target not covered or current bestask already exceeds target; excludes fees and dynamic refill,not a realizable execution forecast.

RPI: Standard book excludes RPI orders. Keep RPI trade notional separate and exclude from primary buy/sell flow. No inference about hidden liquidity,whales or actual cancel events.
reliability: Raw gzip chunks rotate every60sec; feature stream andrun summary stored. Record reconnect boundaries andinvalidate state,wait for snapshots andwarmup. Reconnect with bounded backoff on transport orbook-state failure; stop on disk/backpressure/storagebudget failures. Network loss not detectable solely from sequence gaps; transport andstate checks do not certify exchange completeness.
evaluation_next: Preserve prior hourly surge size and1..6h advance notice target. Aggregate these causal microstructure measurements into prior1/5/15/60min context features only after collecting enough coverage. Pre-register a fixed universe andtraining/calibration/new evaluation boundaries,join mature30h outcomes,retain all candidate andnoncandidate observations,compare same base classifier with/without new data at comparable alert counts. Decide event/sample support before checking evaluation; no selective successful-window storage. This short capture checks infrastructure only.
